verdict.rationale: Glama documents per-tool access control on hosted servers ("enable or disable individual tools"). It also says gateway calls are access-controlled, with marketing that you decide what agents are allowed to do. This covers the individual-tool half of the story. There is no documented server-level allowlist, and no detail on how access policies are scoped per agent. missing for 10: explicit server allowlist/denylist for agents, per-agent or per-key policy scoping, detailed docs on gateway access-control configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
